question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Would you like to see more of Astrid?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get more coffee, and then we can talk more.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You are the clever one.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And though I cannot resist your charms... I will leave you to get the coffee this time. Stay here! I shall be back!
Astrid skips away happily.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank goodness! I'm out of here!
Howard runs out of the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's getting late. Almost four in the afternoon. Got lots of homework, you know.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I know your true plan.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You wish to bring me to a more private place to begin the kissings!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Come along, my hamlet. I will leave with you!
Astrid drags Howard outside by the arm.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid...
Astrid swings Howard around and pushes him behind a tree!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yes, I agree, my moppet. I want to kiss you so bad!
Astrid tries to kiss Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! I have a better idea.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: A better idea?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's both close our eyes... It will make the entire thing more... Special.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You are a devious one, Howard. Of course!
Astrid closes her eyes...
As Howard flees!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Let me give you an earful of advice, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You really don't have to do that.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Shh! Every male needs to experience both sides of the same fish! A boy needs the light and insipid... As well as the dark and the deep!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe that's true...
Astrid shoves the table, pushing both cups of coffee into Howard's lap!
Howard dodges, but some of the coffee still falls on him, seeping into his pants!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Silence! I hate to be interrupted!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I was agreeing with you...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And disagreement is the foundation of love!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Now where was I? I had a story to tell... About the man named Claus who had two loves!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But to tell that story would take days and many finger puppets, which we do not have.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay. You know, Astrid, I'm really more of, uh, a man with one love.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, I see! You are a true walrus of the heart!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that... Good?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I now understand perfectfully who you are. You only wish to love one woman.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh good. I'm glad you got that. Because this was getting really...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: We shall tell the usurper right now that it is I you wish to make the kissings with! Come with me!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: The truth is better when it is fresh and exposed like mackerel on an open-faced sandwich.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, that's not what I meant at all!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Then you mean to say you want to have our relationship in the secret? Meetings in the dark, fumblings in the back of a rusty jalopy?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's not listening! I definitely need to get out of here... But how?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I can tell by your face you are torn with indecision!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But, Howard, you don't have to hide the depths of your passion from me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, that's not it either! Forget all this. Why don't you...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And what have I said about 'normal'?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: `It is boring!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]It is boring![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Exactly! Love is confusion and chaos!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So you are talking about the insipid whale of a cheerleader that you make the sick puppy eyes with. What is she to you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Someone very special. I like her a lot.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Of course you do! You are a feeling being. An electric eel, writhing with emotion!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And as much as I'd like to help you get settled in Centerscore, Astrid... We shouldn't be talking like this.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Of course not, Howard! I have been acting all wrong!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I need to put more aggressiveness into my feelings for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: There are two females in your life! The naive, pure, clean 'girlfriend' and `me`, your darker edge.
nodes.text_bbcode: There are two females in your life! The naive, pure, clean 'girlfriend' and [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color], your darker edge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not sure we're on the same wavelength...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It all makes sense, Howard. What is a meal without both spicy and crunchy, and what kind of boy lives without two girls to depend on?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.prompt: What kind of boy lives without two girls to depend on?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What kind of boy lives without two girls to depend on?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So it is troubles with female friends that you have!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I am happy you said so! I can help with the friendly advice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh good. `Friendly` advice...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh good. [color=#e23b3b][i]Friendly[/i][/color] advice...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What I mean is... I can help you forget any girl...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't need help forgetting this girl.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, her face is like a blot on a paper. Easily passable and not memorable.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I'm not talking about any girl. I'm talking about the girl I'm dating. $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're in a relationship. Which is why I'm uncomfortable being here... With you.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You think it is `my` fault that you are unhappy?
nodes.text_bbcode: You think it is [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] fault that you are unhappy?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I bring you drama, life, passion...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You think you are unhappy... `But you do not know what unhappy means!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You think you are unhappy... [color=#3b78e2][i]But you do not know what unhappy means![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I know 'unhappy'! I know it!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I see in your eyes you don't believe that drama fuels the soul of passion?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Give me a waiter, and I'll show you how drama can move you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! That's fine! I believe you!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Better.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's troubling me is my girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: A female friend?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, the girl I'm dating. $ZOE is my girlfriend. We're in a relationship. Which is why I'm uncomfortable being here with you.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You know, Howard, I have a question for you.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I am but a tragic tourist, lost in the swell of this turbulent American male storm...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean 'maelstrom'... I hope...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I would be so cheerful if you would visit Centerscore with me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You know... Gaze out of my eye sockets, explain the puzzling mysteries, slurp beverages at the disco cafes...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, you want me to show you around?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yes! Tomorrow! Take me to those places where Americans make the kissings in the dark...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, Astrid, I... Er...
$ZOE walks up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I'm ready to go...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Oh, hi, Astrid. How are you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard was just offering me the chance to see a tour of the local coffee shops tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not what I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's very nice of you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, it is... But I know you like it when I drive you home from cheerleading, so if you don't want me to go with Astrid I don't have to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? Because didn't we have some dinner planned tomorrow after school? Or something? Anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, you're free then, aren't you? I have cheerleading until late, remember?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe I could come with you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, you're such a trickster! You tickle my funniest of bones! Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: This is wonderful! Like taking two diving swans to the circus!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I shall see you tomorrow afternoon!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Great.
$ZOE and Howard walk to the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe I have to take Astrid for coffee tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it must be terrible that you have to take a pretty girl out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not `this` pretty girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] pretty girl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you admit she's pretty.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? I didn't... Wait, are you jealous?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that so hard to imagine?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you're the one who gave me permission to go to coffee...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stop me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to control your life, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Still, you should've said `something.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Still, you should've said [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Next time I will.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good.
The next day, at the local coffee shop Common Grounds...
Howard brings over two coffees for him and Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So how do you like America?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I find it to be strange.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And school?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I thought it might be different from back home, but I find classes to be as dull as the carcass of an aged mule...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Biology, huh? Hang in there. I think it gets better.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I weep for home, but you might be right. But for now...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Let us knife to the chase!
Astrid grips Howard's hand and stares into his eyes intensely.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: We have been apart for too long! Tell me what you pine for! What does your troubled heart long for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Why don't you go first?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I love it when you open your eyes like that. It attracts me like a steadfast moth to a flaming star.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Your eyes are so huge. I want to float in them in a big rubber tube while buttering myself with sun cream!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: They are like full moons... Attracting me like waves on a trampoline!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, you're not the first one to say I have big eyes...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Of course not. They are glorious. Now what do you like about `me?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course not. They are glorious. Now what do you like about [color=#3b78e2][i]me?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, this isn't why I'm here. I'm here to show you the local coffee shop. Not to flirt.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And the brooding lover returns! What is troubling you, my lop-sided moppet?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What should I say?
Howard sidesteps Astrid's hug!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You don't wish to congratulate me? I have made your American team of cheerings.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, Astrid, it's great that you made the cheerleading team, but here in America, it's uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's more customary to shake hands than hug...
Astrid takes Howard's hand and gives it a good firm shake!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Shaking your hand is like holding the slippery fish you have just electrocuted...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Those kinds of fish are very lively.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Like `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Like [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, right...
Astrid steps away from Howard.
Howard freezes as Astrid hugs him!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What is wrong? You stiffen like a block of wood, abandoned for days in the rain.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You don't wish to congratulate me? I have made your American team of cheerings.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Surely we can commence by rubbing our bodies together like sticks making fire?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe we could `not` do that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Maybe we could [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] do that...

nodes.text: Astrid pulls away from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Astrid?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ahem! $ZOE, this is Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Centerscore is the new school I will be attending. I am a foreign exchange student!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I have just flown in across the great blue drink, all the way from Norway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're Norwegian?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And you are American! How do you do?
Astrid greets $ZOE with a large hug!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mrph!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's acting more normal than I remember... Well, than she was before...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You are a friend of Howard's? Close as a sister, sweet as an aunt?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I'm his...
The bell to class rings.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, as much fun as it's been catching up, $ZOE and I have class! Bye!
Howard tows $ZOE down the hall and into their classroom!
As they slide into their seats...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who was that girl?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just a girl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She seems to be really `familiar` for being a random stranger.
nodes.text_bbcode: She seems to be really [color=#3b78e2][i]familiar[/i][/color] for being a random stranger.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of a long story, but she's a tourist I ran into when I was abroad in Europe. She took a liking to me and kind of followed me and Hector around...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man, I can't believe she's `here`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, I can't believe she's [color=#e23b3b][i]here[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Howard, $ZOE. Can I start class now, or would you like to continue your conversation?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Ms. Prez.
Howard opens his book as $ZOE looks at the ground.
That night at home, Sam paints her nails while $ZOE talks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what's got you so upset? You barely said anything at dinner...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you're usually the one who's so chipper and bright.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's a new exchange student at school. Astrid Ericson.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that girl. I've seen her around. She's cute.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think Howard thinks so too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? No way! Howard is `your` boyfriend. You don't think he's going to...
nodes.text_bbcode: What? No way! Howard is [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] boyfriend. You don't think he's going to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cheat? No, but you should've seen the way he reacted. He could hardly contain himself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't seen him look at a girl twice since we've been together... But there's just something about Astrid...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've been together for so long. I wonder if Howard's looking for something new.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He'd be dumb as a rock to want to leave you. But if you're really worried about it, confront him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do it, or before you know it, they'll have made out, claiming it was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Saying things like 'But we were trapped in a classroom for several hours together, what else were we supposed to do'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like they couldn't play `poker` or something.
nodes.text_bbcode: Like they couldn't play [color=#3b78e2][i]poker[/i][/color] or something.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't the same, Sam. I'm sure it's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then why are we talking about it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, leave it alone for now, $ZOE. But it could be worth it to talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe...
The next day, Howard goes to walk $ZOE home from cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard, I can't go home yet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ever since we lost Sam, all our routines are off because there's one less person than usual.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So Taylor's holding try-outs for a new cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll take another half-hour to wrap things up. You can go on without me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If it's only another thirty minutes, I'll stay. I have some reading to do anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard!
$ZOE runs back to the cheerleaders, while Howard sits in the bleachers.
Looking over the field, Astrid catches Howard's eye.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! Over here! Watch my triple lutz bear jump!
Astrid does a complicated jump, spinning in the air a few times before landing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You! New girl! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I am trying out the crazy bear jump from the land of my ancestors...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That would be perfect for the middle of the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's exactly the kind of thing we need! Everyone else, go home!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: New girl, you're on the squad! You start Monday!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yay! You have been most generous, giving me the spot. You are like a yellow lampshade.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aren't you sweet? We'll see you next week at practice, new girl. Okay, old girls, huddle!
$ZOE and the other cheerleaders huddle around Taylor as Astrid skips away!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I did it!
Astrid jumps onto the bleachers and runs to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hello, my slippery snake! We meet again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah! How'd you even make that jump?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I have the brawny legs of a plains horse and the arms of a sticky octopus. All the better to catch you!
Astrid reaches forward to hug Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ahhhhhh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow, that was my ear!
At the sound, Astrid faces Howard and walks up to him.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! My innards flutter at the sight of you!
Before Howard can react, Astrid lunges forward and grabs him in a great hug, kissing him soundly on both cheeks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Who is this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And why are her innards 'fluttering'?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's some Norwegian phrase, I think.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's an Astrid thing, I think.
Howard turns on his heel and runs away, but trips!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! Are you okay?
$ZOE helps Howard up.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard!
Astrid turns at the commotion and runs up to Howard, but stops short when she sees $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good thing $ZOE's here... Or Astrid would've made a grab for sure!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It is lovely to see you, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Though you seem to come with some sort of attachment...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Who is this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And why did she refer to me as an attachment?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's some Norwegian phrase, I think.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's certainly an Astrid thing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...
Astrid turns and spies Howard!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! My innards flutter at the sight of you!
Before Howard can react, Astrid lunges forward and grabs him in a great hug, kissing him soundly on both cheeks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Who is this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And why are her innards 'fluttering'?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's some Norwegian phrase, I think.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's certainly an Astrid thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, Howard, I just got a great idea! We should go together! My parents are teaching abroad right now, so we could stay with them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can visit any country you want! Like France or Germany or Italy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It doesn't matter to me, $ZOE. I'll go anywhere with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, guys, I'm all for making out in public, but you two are making me uncomfortable... I'm out.
$ZOE kisses Howard as Hector runs away.
Suddenly, over $ZOE's shoulder, Howard sees...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hello, Centerscore of America! I am here and ready to taste the American experience!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!  How could you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? I'm not covering for anything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are you agreeing to wingman for Hector?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's with Amanda now. His days of casual dating should be over...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're mistaken, $ZOE! We're talking about the dark days `before` Amanda.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're mistaken, $ZOE! We're talking about the dark days [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We were reminiscing about the time I asked him to wingman for me on our trip to Europe. Weren't we, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, yeah! Hector always had a scheme to ask out some girl or another.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We thought you'd be horrified by all the cheesy lines Howard used to come up with.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'You're a lot like a dictionary... You give me meaning.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, that is awful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it sounds like a lot of fun. I didn't know you went to Europe.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh yeah, a long time ago for a class trip. I really enjoyed it. It'd be fun to go back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love Europe too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When did you two go to Europe?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A long time ago for a class trip. Hector and I were reminiscing about our time there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And we were wondering what you thought about traveling abroad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I love Europe! My parents took me on a tour there when I was younger.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I especially love Italy! I bought gelato every day I stayed there! It was wonderful.
One day at school...
Howard is putting his books away when Hector runs up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Dude! I saw the craziest thing! That girl, Astrid, the one from Norway, is here `at` Centerscore!
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude! I saw the craziest thing! That girl, Astrid, the one from Norway, is here [color=#e23b3b][i]at[/i][/color] Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, as in the girl who was obsessed with me? The girl who kept spouting weird phrases and stalking us?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The girl `you` were supposed to make out with?
nodes.text_bbcode: The girl [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] were supposed to make out with?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You forgot the detail about how she kept throwing coffee on the waiters and police officers who chased you two through Europe.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, happy times!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, I don't even want to think about those times.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're gonna have to. You'll be seeing Astrid `every` day now that she's here.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're gonna have to. You'll be seeing Astrid [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] day now that she's here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's here for good?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's a foreign exchange student. Like Jean-Paul, except not deported.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, this almost makes me wish I was still sharing my room with the guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You think she knows I'm at this school?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who knows?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I wouldn't worry about it too much, man. Centerscore's huge, and you're surrounded by friends. What's the worst she can do to you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right, but... If she does go back to stalking me... What will $ZOE think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What will I think about what?
$ZOE peers around Howard's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, you guys! What are you two talking so secretively about?
Howard and Hector exchange glances.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I certainly don't want her to know about Astrid...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We were talking about...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, did you hear what I said?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You said that I was paying too much attention to Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...So you `were` listening.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So you [color=#3b78e2][i]were[/i][/color] listening.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course. I don't like to see you upset.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't be mad, $ZOE. I was talking to Astrid a lot because I wanted to show you that I didn't like her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How was that supposed to convince me otherwise?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wanted you to see how crazy she was.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just made you look like you were flirting with her!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're not going to be getting coffee or making 'kissy faces' or anything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: From now on, we make, uh, friendly faces.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, let's try that again. Astrid, it seems pretty clear you have feelings for me.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, I can be very friendly...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Like an errant bird loves the sun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I have to tell you that I want to make things work with $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And she and I both feel that it would be better if you and I don't hang out at all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe we can be friends one day, but not right now. Does that make sense?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Are... Are you spurning me?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not in those words...
Erik comes back with a tray of coffee that he sets on a table.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I brought five mugs! One for Howard, and four for you! Just the way you like it.
Erik looks from Astrid to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, is now a good time?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Now is a `great` time!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now is a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] time!

nodes.text: Astrid picks up a mug of coffee and hefts it in her right hand.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Eep! She's going to throw it!
Erik runs out of the room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you.. You're not going to...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You have spurned me... And when one spurns another... The other must spurn back in magnitudes!
Astrid whips the cup at Howard!
Howard is too slow to react!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaiiiiiiiieeeee!
Astrid picks up a second cup.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What is there to know? We are practically made for each other!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Like two halves of a brain, or the cleaved insides of the harvest hog!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gross.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Do not speak little of you and me! Together, we make sparks like a welding tool soldering metal plates together!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: We are made for each other!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wanted to talk to you about our 'rightness' for each other...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have to tell you we are not going to work.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: An ultimatum? So official-sounding...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It is that kind of talk that makes me want to take a bite out of you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, put that feeling aside. There will be no biting here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We are not going to work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, did you hear what I said?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, why are you angry again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you blind? Because of Astrid! Are you sure you don't like her? You're certainly paying a lot of attention to her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, about that... I had a plan.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A plan?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I wanted to show you that Astrid is way more crazy than you are!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you saying `I'm` crazy?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you saying [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] crazy?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! You're `not` crazy. She is. I was trying to point out the differences between you.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! You're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] crazy. She is. I was trying to point out the differences between you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, of course we're different.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You were supposed to feel better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I don't!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Were you `flirting` with Astrid just now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Were you [color=#3b78e2][i]flirting[/i][/color] with Astrid just now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! I was trying to show you she was crazy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? Because bringing her coffee and staring at her across the table looks a lot like `flirting!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? Because bringing her coffee and staring at her across the table looks a lot like [color=#3b78e2][i]flirting![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But enough about Bjorn! Tell me American things! What is a chowder, and why do clams make it?
$ZOE leans over to Howard and whispers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, can we talk for a second?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, er, sure!
$ZOE pulls Howard outside the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What was [color=#3b78e2][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What was what?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I was about to tell the rest of the story!
In her anger, Astrid pushes the coffee!
It spills over the table edge and pools on the tile below.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, watch it... White skirt, black coffee? No way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! What did you do then?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What does it matter?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: There was no good reason! There couldn't have been!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But it warms my fingertips to know you care.
Astrid smiles at Howard and calmly drinks out of her coffee cup.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why didn't that work?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, she hates it whenever anyone `agrees` with her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, she hates it whenever anyone [color=#e23b3b][i]agrees[/i][/color] with her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, weirdo.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Astrid, you're from Norway, right? Is that close to France?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They say that in France, no one gains weight!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Norway and France are close like cousins, but not like cats.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh! So what's it like in Norway?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Clean. We have beautiful fjords...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like the car?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No, like the ice mountain giants.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh, Astrid, tell us something about you! Like, do you have a `man` in your life?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, Astrid, tell us something about you! Like, do you have a [color=#3b78e2][i]man[/i][/color] in your life?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Perfect! This is my chance! I just need to interrupt her, and Astrid will send that coffee cup tumbling!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: There was one man... But I got rid of him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: His name was Bjorn... And he and I were in the oven of love!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But I was not the only crooked cake he was baking with! He was seeing another! The cinnamon cake of one named Ingrid!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love cinnamon cake!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what did you do?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I sharpened the knives... And cut him out. What else would I do? Him and Ingrid... Ha!

options.label: What if he had a good reason?

nodes.text: Howard hands Astrid a cup, makes eye contact, and...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard, your eyes are as big as fully ripened coconuts.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: They are like full moons...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Tugging me like sea lions to brisket!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's... An interesting comparison...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow, she `really` likes your eyes, Howard!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, she [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] likes your eyes, Howard!

nodes.text: Howard hands Astrid a cup, makes eye contact, and...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What is it, moopy face? Is the sun shining brightful in your eyes?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, Howard, you look so angry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You want some sunglasses?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. I was just trying something out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Get Astrid to act nuts at the center table tomorrow at lunch.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hand her a cup of coffee! And then, as soon as Taylor says something to annoy Astrid... `Bam!` Coffee in Taylor's face!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hand her a cup of coffee! And then, as soon as Taylor says something to annoy Astrid... [color=#e23b3b][i]Bam![/i][/color] Coffee in Taylor's face!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It won't be that easy.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She only seems to act out when we're alone together.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, you know the answer to that, right? Lure out the nuttiness! Bait crazy with crazy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Figure out whatever it is that you do that makes her go psycho.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't `do` anything! She comes that way.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] anything! She comes that way.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You didn't provoke her at all? You didn't act flirty, or bring up her favorite topic, or touch her leg?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! I just got us coffees, started talking about school... Oh, I did make eye contact, and she did say she liked my big eyes. `That` made her go on for a while.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I just got us coffees, started talking about school... Oh, I did make eye contact, and she did say she liked my big eyes. [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] made her go on for a while.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, that's one thing you can try tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And she did dump coffee on me when I interrupted her...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That'll be easy to do. See? You're already halfway there.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Astrid will go off the deep end, $ZOE will feel better, and hopefully the rest of the school will think she's weird, and she'll be out of your hair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Isn't it a little mean?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's a pretty girl, Howard. She'll be all right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That might be crazy enough to work.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know, I thought of it! Now, if you'll let me get back to puzzle-making?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Oh. Right.
The next day, Howard enters the cafeteria with his lunch and coffee.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here goes nothing.
Howard slides next to $ZOE at the cheerleaders' table. Across from him, Astrid smiles widely.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, coffee much, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why'd you bring two cups?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're both for me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's okay, sweetie. I know exactly what you're doing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm telling you it's not going to work!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How do you know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I took the coffee diet for a couple days.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It just made me super energized for a couple hours, then I crashed and slept for a day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, this isn't a diet. It'll be much better than that. Like a show.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I like shows!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I just like the coffee.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You want one of the cups, Astrid? I'm willing to share.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It would be pleasurable to take a cup.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now's my chance. I know she likes my eyes. I'm going to hand her coffee and look straight at her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just need to figure out which expression to make. I should look...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That is the worst idea I've ever heard.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You tell $ZOE you're not interested in Astrid...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's going to think you `are` interested in Astrid!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's going to think you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] interested in Astrid!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? How does that make sense?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Reverse psychology. All girls have it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think that's what that means.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you plant the idea of liking Astrid in $ZOE's head, it'll sprout like a sprouting thing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what should I do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Correct!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Show $ZOE that Astrid is a few screws loose of a full-blown cannon, and she'll feel better about your relationship.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That `sounds` like a good idea...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]sounds[/i][/color] like a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But how am I supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's simple, bro.
At home, Hector is putting the finishing touches on his masterpiece...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ten more pieces to put in place, and it'll be complete!
When Howard bursts into his room!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhhh! What are you doing here? ...And why is there coffee on your jeans?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did she follow me? I don't think she followed me...
Howard frantically peeks out each window in the room, then starts pacing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, man. Slow down. You almost knocked over all my hard work!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, that's a puzzle with a picture of a unicorn on it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a minute. `Why` are you making a puzzle with a picture of a unicorn on it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute. [color=#e23b3b][i]Why[/i][/color] are you making a puzzle with a picture of a unicorn on it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh, it's this funny thing. See, when Amanda and I are making out, sometimes she...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nope, stop right there, don't want to know.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But you don't look so good. What's wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's Astrid. I took her to a coffee shop...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And here I thought you knew better than to go barking up that tree.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't bark. If anything, she's barking up my tree!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, I could've lived without that image in my head.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, wait, wait... You're mad because you have an amazing girlfriend `and` a hot girl going after you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, wait, wait... You're mad because you have an amazing girlfriend [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] a hot girl going after you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, when you put it like that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes! She tried to convince me that I needed two women in my life!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you turned that down?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Hector...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hector...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, all right. Fine. Sounds like you have a problem.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was hard enough getting rid of Astrid in Europe, but now that she's moved here? I'll never be able to shake her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Plus, now that she's made the cheerleading squad, I'm going to start seeing her every time I see $ZOE. And $ZOE is jealous of her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can't really do anything about Astrid. Crazy does as crazy does. But with `$ZOE...` The solution to your problem is right in front of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't really do anything about Astrid. Crazy does as crazy does. But with [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE...[/i][/color] The solution to your problem is right in front of you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How's that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE is a girl. She is jealous because all she sees is another pretty girl hitting on her boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Astrid is nuts. All you have to do to make $ZOE happy is prove it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not sure I follow. I have to prove...
But not quite perfectly. Play again to get that perfect score!
Or else, come back next time to see what will happen to the rest of the Centerscore students in Surviving High School!
And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Astrid, you don't want to do that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why not? Because it hurts?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Because of Ingrid.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ingrid? The fish-slapping snake that my lovely Bjorn went away with?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What does `she` have to do with this?
nodes.text_bbcode: What does [color=#e23b3b][i]she[/i][/color] have to do with this?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The way things are right now... I'm Bjorn, $ZOE is you, and you are Ingrid.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I... Am... Ingrid?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I was afraid of this.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You and the insipid whale are like penguins gliding on the ice of love!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Then I never had a chance.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope you understand...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I know I may seem off-putting to you, but I do understand the messy tangle of knots that is the human heart!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And though my heart hangs like a low fruit on the tree of self-destruction, I hear what you are saying.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: If you feel the churnings of day-old love, then I will leave you alone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good... I think.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to go home now. Thanks for, uh, the coffee.
Astrid regards Howard's shirt.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Do you not want me to wash the stain off for you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not necessary...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I insist.
Astrid grabs the shirt, tugging it over Howard's head!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, you don't have to do this!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It's not a problem.
Astrid has just succeeded in getting Howard's shirt off when...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was coming to drop off Astrid's cheerleading uniform. Erik let me in. He told me Astrid was downstairs, so I thought I'd...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I don't have to answer that. The better question is... What are `you` doing here with `your shirt` in `Astrid's` hands?!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I don't have to answer that. The better question is... What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here with [color=#3b78e2][i]your shirt[/i][/color] in [color=#3b78e2][i]Astrid's[/i][/color] hands?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This looks bad.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But $ZOE, it was necessary!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have a reason, a good one!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I can't believe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...
$ZOE turns and runs out the door! Howard freezes, dumbly.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What are you doing, you oil-slicked oaf?! Be like the lion on the fierce savannah! Run after your antelope!
Howard runs out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? Where are you? `ZOE?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE? Where are you? [color=#e23b3b][i]ZOE?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard runs down the block and finds her sitting on the curb a couple houses away. He sits next to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There you are. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle... What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Can I explain?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. Please explain `why` you were `shirtless` in Astrid's house.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. Please explain [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] you were [color=#3b78e2][i]shirtless[/i][/color] in Astrid's house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you really think anything happened? I went over to Astrid's to talk.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ever since our fight, I've been trying to keep away from her, but she kept popping up wherever I was!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I figured she was following me, so I decided to tell her to stop.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid was taking off my shirt because she threw coffee at me when I told her you were the only girl I wanted in my life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I understand if you don't believe me, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I believe you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're too nice of a guy to treat me badly. Besides, you reek of coffee.
Howard slings an arm around $ZOE's shoulder and kisses her cheek.
